en: Black-and-white postcard showing a historic train station building with brick walls, arched windows, and steep dark roofs with small spires and decorative ironwork. Several people stand in front of the entrance, and many bicycles are parked along the facade. In the foreground is a cobblestone square with a lamppost and a freestanding information/phone kiosk. The lower margin of the image contains the caption 'KARLSTAD. Centralstationen.'
